{{Quote|We've filed a complaint with the Imperial Research Division for carrying out class 5 biological experiments on an inhabited world, but I think it's going to be a long time before we see anything come of that.|[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:G" />}}
The '''Imperial Research Division''' was an organization dedicated to study and research for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In addition to its role in [[Science/Legends|scientific]] research, the Imperial Research Division was also tasked to oversee and control private research throughout the galaxy. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Corellian Security Force]] discovered an illegal and dangerous [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] project conducted by the [[GeneTech Syndicate]] company on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and dubbed [[Parasophic Arachne]] program. Its objective was to create an intelligent and powerful form of [[arachne]]s. The CorSec later filed a complaint with the Imperial Research Division against the GeneTech Syndicate for carrying out class 5 biological experiments on an inhabited world.<ref name="SWG:G" />
